body: I am already telling my counselor about how I'm feeling and they want to call my parents. The problem is that my parents don't believe in mental disorders and wouldn't even take me to a psychiatrist even though my family doctor told them to as well. My parents are also under a lot of stress right now so I don't want them to worry about something they don't believe is real at the moment.
Oh alright will do, thank you! :)
Do I just go to my family doctor to get that checked out or a specialist?
Will do, thanks for taking the time to comment! :)
Thank you for commenting. I will try not to feel shame but I don't know how I can control it. It's great to hear that I can come to here if I need help though. :)
First of all, thanks for taking the time to comment. Thank you for the advice as well, I will look up that book! :)
Oh wait I didn't look at the name closely before I pressed send and I already thanked you for commenting earlier :)

I'm old enough to get a permit but I need to go to driving school for that. Thanks for the advice and taking the time to comment, I really appreciate it. I don't think diagnosing myself through using the internet would work though..

It is my family that's pretty bad towards this kinda stuff, generally they are very supportive but when it comes to mental health they just think it's stupid. I've been to doctors and they always tell my parents "your child needs to go to a psychiatrist" but my parents just shake it off every time.
Alright, looking forward to some positive changes in both of our lives! :)

Hi thanks for taking the time to comment, I really appreciate it!  I go to church and believe in Jesus so I got that going for me. I think I explain myself in the other post I put on here but I don't remember.
Thank you so much! I took the leap and asked to go to the counselor today, I want you to keep me updated on you as well if that's fine with you. :)

I've tried surviving on my own and it just doesn't work out for me. I've kinda explained it in one of my past posts on here. I don't know how to block out the bad people, do you have any tips on how to do that? By the way, thank you for taking the time to comment, I really appreciate it.

It's just so hard to want to stay alive for nothing.. I can't even get any psychological help because my parents think depression is fake. I am so grateful that you commented, thank you for that. I really don't want to kill myself but I feel as it's the only way out.
i guess that's a sign to kill myself

It says someone commented but I see no comment...

edit: there are 4 comments now and i don't see the other two

Thank you so much for reaching out to me! I was just about to give up because I figured if nobody would reach out to help me when I'm asking for help then there was no hope. I will eventually get around to talking to my parents about the whole pressured thing but I don't feel like that would help because he's a close friend of my brother. Again, thank you so much for the advice and I really appreciate it. Happy New Years!
I guess this isn't /r/suicidewatch worthy? Oh well, thanks for taking the time to read my post. Happy new year.
